summary.text: Spencer Deery is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 23 since November 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as deputy chief of staff.

paragraphs.text: Deery earned a bachelor's degree in communications from Brigham Young University in 2006 and a master's degree in public administration from George Washington University in 2011.
His career experience includes working as deputy chief of staff, senior communications strategist and public policy analyst with the Purdue University Office of the President.
Deery assumed office in the state Senate on November 9, 2022, succeeding Phil Boots.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce and Technology, Education and Career Development, Health and Provider Services, and Utilities committees.
